project_type: Home Assistant custom integration (Bluetooth media player for TCL Soundbar)
build_system: None (custom component installed into HA config directory)
test_framework: pytest with unittest.mock stubs for homeassistant modules
verification_instructions: 1. Run pytest on tests/test_protocol.py. 2. Verify Python import syntax with ast.parse on modified files.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network - can install packages. No HA runtime available so full integration testing not possible. Use AST validation and unit tests.
key_patterns: Entity uses _attr_* pattern for state. Protocol is in protocol.py (pure logic). media_player.py has the entity class. config_flow.py handles discovery and manual setup.
directory_structure: custom_components/tcl_soundbar/ contains the integration. tests/ contains protocol unit tests. apk/ is a reverse-engineered Android app (not relevant to code changes).
